arms.better: With the verbatim issue text, tm never produced a patch or ran verification. Across repeated inspections it reported 213,149 tokens for 11 tool calls in 30 seconds, and ended after 10 repeated no-progress steps; it also hit a provider 429. It reported failure honestly and pointed to `tm --resume S-6`, but a user may be confused by the internal `meta-contributor` provider error and by the instruction to resume rather than a clear retry action for transient rate limiting. Improve repeated-inspection detection so rereading the same source cannot consume a huge token budget, and provide a visible, bounded backoff/retry path for provider rate limits. Setup warned that the requested `[test]` extra does not exist; verification required installing test/type-check tools manually.

OpenCode found the implementation quickly, attempted both mypy and pyright, corrected the typing issues they reported, added an assert_type check, and clearly distinguished static typing checks from pytest collection. After the fix PR's tests were overwritten into place, the Path tests passed (8 passed, 1 skipped), and both mypy and pyright passed against the PR typing test. It could improve its initial discovery by directly locating the test files rather than first trying a nonmatching glob, and should preserve the issue's prescribed standalone typing test rather than adding coverage to an existing typing_prompt.py file.
